proof_role: installed observation non-mutation, explicit recovery preservation, retained remote reconciliation integrity, and subprocess error classification
determinism: isolated fixed records, deterministic crash point, byte and registration inventories; no timing threshold
resources: bounded local CPU/disk and Git, copied candidate executable, no network or paid services

denominators.local_diagnostics: 5 routes x 4 states x 2 genuine checkout topologies = 40 observations
denominators.helpers: 3 helpers x 4 fixture input states x 2 checkout topologies = 24 observations; helper construction/readiness is separate from issue readiness
denominators.remote_diagnostics: 4 remote states x 2 topologies = 8 observations, plus settled and corrupted-receipt observations after explicit recovery in each topology
denominators.release: historical inventory-scoped fixture explicitly isolates later Cargo inputs, then rejects an introduced unlisted package; exact-candidate negative matrix plus linked healthy/missing/corrupt/pending qualification gate observations
denominators.merge_evidence: settled native fake-transport merge, then wrong PR/missing reconciliation/corrupt JSON/altered merge identity, restoring and rechecking valid evidence after each case
denominators.created_pr_evidence: native reconciled create with no request PR and a positive receipt target; reject null/zero receipt targets without confusing historical and currently observed PR numbers
denominators.attempt_corpus: 17 installed attempts from prepare through proof/review/publication checks, fake PR create/readback, terminal finish and clean-control preview/removal; 14 completed, two blocked, one interrupted; no abandonment or censoring in this baseline
denominators.measurement_failures: separate regressions retain spawn failure and malformed-output consumer failure as failed, and collector interruption as censored
denominators.credential_transport: stdin payload, argv exclusion, selected credential environment, absence of ambient home/proxy/other token, redaction before output truncation, and first-argument -q preventing real curl default-config output redirection in an isolated file:// fixture

non_claims: Model-only helpers and remote owner unit tests do not establish installed entrypoint purity on their own.

Review receipt inputs are explicitly synthetic; readback is produced by native observation over fake transport. The remote merge is a declared fixture event, and eligible cleanup uses a separate genuinely registered clean control at the same head; the dirty issue checkout is retained.
Invocation counts cover installed CLI entrypoints and fake remote transport, excluding internal Git utilities. Injected clock values and measured durations are not causal savings evidence.
Local fixture proof is distinct from CI integration and production reliability.
